People don't do their research on some of the items and it turns out they were just dealing with a drop seller playing a long con. If you see the exact product being sold by 2 different companies it's likely that one is just drop selling goods, it's easy to spot when you see their full offering list is only other manufacturers goods and they've only been around for less than a year. Free samples and outrageous price guarantees, same exact products(some just steal images) as companies who have been around for longer than 5+ years and multiple companies registered to the same phone number and addresses are big red flags. They will often not have a brokerage company. So if you want to be 100% find out if they have a cargo agent and if so which one. If it's not a fake company also(I've seen this shit too) you can find out from the cargo agent if that company is an actual manufacturer or if they even do business with the brokerage/cargo agent firm or as claimed.
